objective.name: J
objective.description: Objective with material cost, displacement penalty on Gamma_D, and negative vertical load work on Gamma_N

state_equation.description: Linear elasticity state equation with gravity load, Neumann traction and penalty on Gamma_D
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{\Gamma_D}\beta(\mathbf u\cdot\delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x+\int_{\Gamma_N}q(\mathbf e_y\cdot\delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x+\int_D\rho g\chi(\mathbf e_y\cdot\delta\mathbf u)\,dx+\int_D((\mathbf I\lambda\,\operatorname{tr}(\bm\varepsilon(\mathbf u))+2\mu\bm\varepsilon(\mathbf u)):\pmb\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf u)^\top)\,dx

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint equation for the displacement state
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)}J(\delta\mathbf u,\mathbf u)+\int_{\Gamma_D}\beta(\delta\mathbf u\cdot\tilde{\mathbf u})\,ds_x+\int_D((\mathbf I\lambda\,\operatorname{tr}(\partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)}\bm\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf u))+2\mu\partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)}\bm\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf u)):\bm\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx

boundaries.name: \Gamma_N
boundaries.rationale: Extracted Gamma_N reconciled to mesh label 3 (top edge) where the vertical traction q e_y is applied.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_{free,1}

boundaries.rationale: Remaining mesh label 5; homogeneous Neumann boundary.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Displacement field extracted from the spec; P2 vector field for elasticity. The Gamma_D condition is enforced through the beta penalty, so no strong Dirichlet labels are set.

optimization_config.hmin_rationale: Approximately 1/1000 of the unit-sized design domain, resolving fine structural members.
optimization_config.hmax_rationale: Approximately 1/10 of the unit-sized design domain for the background mesh.
optimization_config.diffusion_rationale: Small Tikhonov regularization for the level-set advection equation.
optimization_config.v0_rationale: Advection velocity scale in the 1e-3 to 1e-2 range for stable level-set updates.
optimization_config.iterations_rationale: Balances computational cost and convergence for two-dimensional topology optimization.
optimization_config.level_set_initial_rationale: Initial solid outside a central circle; material connects the left support (label 4) and the top loaded edge (label 3).
optimization_config.boundary_labels_rationale: Homogeneous-Neumann boundaries that may evolve freely in the shape sensitivity.
optimization_config.fixed_labels_rationale: Gamma_N (label 3) and Gamma_D (label 4) carry the prescribed load/support conditions and are held geometrically fixed.

extra_params.filter_radius_rationale: 1.5*hmin spatial regularization for the level-set velocity.
extra_params.reinit_interval_rationale: Signed-distance reinitialization every five iterations to maintain a stable level-set evolution.

optimization_config.rationale: Constructed optimization configuration: mesh and boundary labels from the extracted spec; numerical parameters and initial level-set chosen for a robust two-dimensional topology optimization.
